svg.desc: Heatmap showing offensive snap share percentages by week for NFL skill position players (QB, RB, WR, TE). Each cell is colored by snap share percentage, with darker colors indicating higher snap share. Additional metrics shown include targets, yards after catch, first downs, and completion percentage.
